pitfalls.summary: Testimonials are wp_posts rows (post_type=wpm-testimonial) with no dedicated table and no show_in_rest -- reading the posts table WITHOUT this entity's declared where-filter would return every post type on the site (products, pages, attachments, etc.), not just testimonials. sampleStructureRequest.where is mandatory here, not optional -- enforced by plugin-knowledge.js's SHARED_CORE_TABLES_REQUIRING_WHERE check.

Rating, category, and other structured fields (if used) live in postmeta keys. These are READABLE through wix-wp-plugin-v2, key-scoped: list the distinct meta_key values for these testimonials' post ids, then read the keys that matter with a scoped request (max 50 keys). Postmeta is not refused -- do not accept a metadata gap here without running the two-step read first. post_title/post_content/post_status/dates remain directly readable from wp_posts.

VERIFIED LIVE 2026-08-29: a filtered query against the posts table (where post_type = wpm-testimonial) executes correctly and may return zero rows when the plugin is active but unused -- the mechanism is real and reachable; an empty result means there is nothing to migrate.

blocked.resolution: wix-wp-plugin-v2 can read the shared posts table filtered to this plugin's post_type -- VERIFIED LIVE 2026-08-29: a filtered query (where post_type = wpm-testimonial) executes correctly and returns pagingMetadata.total (0 when no testimonials are configured). Reachability is confirmed; fulfillment wiring is deferred until a Wix target is researched and approved at the mapping review. The working filtered query, for reference once a target is approved: select ID/post_title/post_content/post_excerpt/post_status/post_date where post_type=wpm-testimonial, orderBy ID asc.

quirks: Registers custom post type wpm-testimonial: author (post_title), body (post_content). Confirmed via the plugin's own source (shortcode-form.php).

No native Wix target researched or approved yet -- do not assume a generic CMS collection is the right landing spot without that approval (see e.g. Wix Stores' native wishlist feature, which was nearly mis-defaulted to CMS the same way for a different plugin). Do not wire the testimonial entity's blocked[] fulfillment on your own judgment before that target decision is made.
